title: Add E2E tests: Optimize Suggestions RBAC denied + empty telemetry + pagination/sorting
author: Leila Farouk
description: Summary: Adds Playwright E2E coverage for the Console “Optimization suggestions” beta page focusing on (1) RBAC denied flows, (2) empty/insufficient telemetry states, and (3) pagination + sorting correctness for the suggestions table. Motivation: We’ve had repeated regressions during beta iteration where the Suggestions page either silently rendered empty for users lacking optimize:suggestions:read or showed the wrong empty-state CTA when telemetry lagged. This PR converts the checklist in ENG-19501 into deterministic E2E tests that run in CI and exercise the real routing/table components rather than unit-testing the view model. What’s included: - RBAC denied: verifies that a user without optimize:suggestions:read sees the access denied panel, does not fire list fetch retries, and does not emit “impression” analytics events. Also verifies that a user with project access but missing optimize scope is denied (org membership alone is insufficient). - Feature flag gating: validates that when the Suggestions beta flag is off, the navigation entry does not appear and direct navigation shows the “not enabled” state (with link to internal setup doc in non-prod builds). - Empty states: (a) “insufficient telemetry” state when API returns empty with reason=INSUFFICIENT_TELEMETRY, confirms CTA deep-links to telemetry setup page; (b) “no opportunities” state when API returns empty with reason=NO_SUGGESTIONS and telemetry_present=true; (c) stale estimate banner rendering when response includes stale_as_of older than threshold. - Pagination/sorting: asserts that query params are forwarded correctly (page_size, cursor, sort_by, sort_dir) and that the table updates deterministically when changing sort from savings_$ to risk and back. Also verifies that stable suggestion IDs are used as row keys (no row duplication when paginating). Test approach: - Uses Playwright with seeded org/project fixtures and two test users: qa-suggestions-read and qa-no-suggestions-read. RBAC is configured via test-only authz bootstrap endpoint already used by other console E2Es. - Network layer: stubs /optimize/suggestions responses with recorded fixtures for each scenario; additionally asserts request payload/params to catch UI regressions around sorting/pagination. - Flake control: avoids arbitrary timeouts; waits on explicit “table loaded” data-testid markers and ensures all fetches are resolved before snapshotting key panels. - Analytics: intercepts /events ingestion endpoint and asserts event emission (or lack thereof) for impression/expand in the allowed vs denied cases. Out of scope: validating estimator math (covered by unit tests in pr-22044) and backend RBAC enforcement (covered by API tests in pr-22026). Screenshots: attached in PR artifacts (playwright-report) for denied/empty states. Risk: low; tests only. Backward compatibility: N/A. Notes for reviewers: please focus on determinism/flake risk and whether we’re asserting the right empty-state copy/CTAs per latest design.
commits: test(console-e2e): add suggestions RBAC denied coverage
test(console-e2e): add suggestions empty state fixtures + assertions
test(console-e2e): add sorting/pagination assertions for suggestions table
chore(test): stabilize waits + data-testid hooks for suggestions page
review_conversation: Kaitlyn Nguyen: Can we ensure the denied flow doesn’t emit impressions? We’ve had audit concerns about recording UI events when access is denied. Leila Farouk: Yep — added an explicit assertion that /events has zero calls for the denied user and one call for the allowed user after page load. Felix Schneider: For empty states, can we assert the reason value rather than matching copy? Copy is still moving. Leila Farouk: I’m asserting the visible state header + CTA destination, and also that the API fixture includes reason=INSUFFICIENT_TELEMETRY vs NO_SUGGESTIONS. Happy to reduce copy matching; updated to target data-testid + link href rather than exact strings. Nora Ahmed: Sorting test looks brittle; it assumes the first row is always X. Better to verify the request params + that the column sort indicator changes. Leila Farouk: Good call — refactored to assert the outgoing sort_by/sort_dir params and the aria-sort attribute on the column header; removed dependence on row order except for ensuring no duplicate IDs across pages. Dylan Brooks: Any new data-testid hooks must be stable and not leak into public docs. Leila Farouk: Added only data-testid attributes under existing patterns; no user-facing changes. Approvals: Kaitlyn Nguyen approved after analytics assertion change. Nora Ahmed approved after sorting test refactor. Felix Schneider approved. Dylan Brooks approved.
